title: Dashboard Overview
description: A studio dashboard with four KPIs, a revenue chart, recent activity and project progress, built from real layout and data primitives.
summary: KPIs, a hand-drawn revenue chart, activity and project health.
notes: All figures, names and activity are sample data. Wire the block to your own queries before shipping it.
The reporting-period control is navigation, not a working date filter. The chart is a static inline SVG.
The chart has a text summary for assistive technology; the visible labels are plain HTML.
